findings.title: SQL Injection (UNION) — credential dump at /vulnerabilities/sqli/
findings.expected: Authenticated UNION SELECT dumps the users table: admin/5f4dcc3b... (md5(password)), gordonb/e99a18c4..., 1337/8d3533d7..., pablo/0d107d09..., smithy/5f4dcc3b...
findings.observed: All five username:md5(password) rows returned by the 'Surname:' column. md5 hashes for admin and smithy = 5f4dcc3b5aa765d61d8327deb882cf99 (md5('password')).

findings.title: OS Command Injection at /vulnerabilities/exec/
findings.expected: POST field ip=127.0.0.1; id triggers shell metacharacter execution and 'id' output appears after ping output.
findings.observed: Response body shows full ping trace followed by 'uid=33(www-data) gid=33(www-data) groups=33(www-data)' — RCE as www-data confirmed.

findings.title: Local File Inclusion at /vulnerabilities/fi/
findings.expected: Absolute path in ?page= is read directly (include/require with no whitelist or traversal guard).
findings.observed: Response body contains /etc/passwd verbatim, including 'root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash' line.

findings.title: Reflected XSS at /vulnerabilities/xss_r/
findings.expected:
User-supplied name param reflected without HTML encoding into 
Hello ...
.
findings.observed: Raw payload 'Hello <script>alert(1)</script>' rendered in response body.

findings.title: Stored XSS at /vulnerabilities/xss_s/
findings.expected: Stored payload persists and renders for every subsequent visitor (no input/output sanitization).
findings.observed:
After POST of txtName=evil&mtxMessage=&btnSign=Sign Guestbook, a subsequent GET to /vulnerabilities/xss_s/ contains 'Name: evil
Message: '.

findings.title: Blind SQL Injection (boolean) at /vulnerabilities/sqli_blind/
steps: EXPECT User ID exists in the database.
EXPECT User ID is MISSING from the database.
findings.expected: Boolean differential (true/false) confirms blind injection without UNION output.
findings.observed: id=1 returns 'User ID exists in the database.'; id=1' AND 1=2-- - returns 'User ID is MISSING from the database.'

findings.title: Unrestricted File Upload -> Webshell RCE at /vulnerabilities/upload/
findings.expected: Server accepts .php file upload with no extension/MIME/content checks, stores it in web-accessible /hackable/uploads/, and the PHP engine executes it server-side.
findings.observed: Upload POST returned '.../hackable/uploads/shell.php succesfully uploaded!'. Subsequent GET /hackable/uploads/shell.php returned 'PWNED_BY_DVWA_UPLOAD' followed by phpinfo() output (PHP Version banner in HTML) — arbitrary code execution as www-data.

findings.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery on admin password change at /vulnerabilities/csrf/
findings.expected: Password change form action='#', method='GET' (no anti-CSRF token). Any cross-origin GET (e.g., ) can change admin password if victim clicks attacker link.
findings.observed: Form exposes fields password_new/password_conf/Change with action='#' and method='GET'. POST submission accepted without token verification — original 'password' reverted in subsequent test (confirms endpoint mutates state).

findings.title: Login brute-forceable (no lockout/throttling) at /vulnerabilities/brute/
findings.expected: Login endpoint returns generic error on bad credentials with no rate-limit / lockout / CAPTCHA, enabling offline/online brute force.
findings.observed:
GET with username=admin&password=wrong returns '

Username and/or password incorrect.
' — single-attempt confirmation, no throttling evident.
